//go:build !windows

package main

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestPrivateFixtureRejectsModeAndSymlinkChanges(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	directory := filepath.Join(root, "private-state")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	link := filepath.Join(root, "link")
	if err := os.Symlink(directory, link); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(link); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("symlink directory accepted")
	}
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(filepath.Join(link, "child")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("directory created through symlink parent")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "state")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("state"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("public state accepted")
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(path, 0400); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unexpected owner permissions accepted")
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(directory, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("public directory accepted")
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("state sealed under unprivate parent")
	}
}
